data.desc: Endava is a leading provider of next-generation technology services dedicated to enabling its clients to accelerate growth, tackle complex challenges and thrive in evolving markets. Endava embeds AI across the design and delivery of technology transformation, combining it with deep industry expertise to deliver measurable client outcomes with greater speed and precision. Central to Endava's model is Dava.Flow, its AI-native engagement lifecycle with governance, traceability and transparency built into the delivery process. Endava's clients span payments, insurance, banking and capital markets, technology, media, telecommunications, healthcare, mobility, retail and consumer goods and more. The Company's team of more than 10,000 Endavans helps clients break new ground from locations in Europe, the Americas, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.
